blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippines captured the bronze medal in the boys doubles event of the inaugural ASTAF U19 Asian Sepak Takraw Championship on Friday at Rizal Memorial Coliseum. The Filipino trio of Archie Gabriel Gilva, Jerald Owen Evangelio and Julian Gamanay lost to an Indonesian side led by Mohamad Djafar and 20th Asian Games veteran Muhammad Rohman, 5-15, 6-15, in the semifinals.
